abort.single_instance_allowed: Hearth is already set up. Add rooms from its Configure button.

user.title: Hearth
user.description: Hearth runs every room's heating the same way, whatever heats it. Choose the thermostat that switches the boiler for your radiators, if you have any. You'll add rooms next, from Configure.

menu_options.add_radiator: Add a room with radiator valves

add_radiator.title: Room with radiator valves
add_radiator.description: Hearth runs this room's schedule, sets its valves, and switches the boiler on when it needs heat. A room sensor away from the radiator gives a truer reading than the valve's own.

add_underfloor.title: Underfloor room
add_underfloor.description: The Heatmiser stat runs this room's schedule itself, so it keeps its own early start and carries on if Home Assistant is down. Hearth writes the schedule to the neoHub as a profile.

data.name: Name
data.profile: Profile name on the neoHub (default: Hearth and the room's name)

data.boiler_on_temp: Thermostat set to this when radiators want heat
data.boiler_off_temp: Thermostat set to this when they don't
data.fallback_temp: Thermostat left at this if Hearth stops
data.demand_on_delay: Wait before switching the boiler on
data.preheat_max_minutes: Radiator rooms warm up early by up to (0 turns it off)
data.away_temp: Away: rooms held no warmer than
data.off_temp: A room that's off is kept above
data.boiler_switch: Call for heat switch (instead of setting the thermostat's temperature)

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Set a room's weekday and weekend schedule. Each day is a list of changes, up to six, like {"time": "06:30", "temp": 19}.

boost.name: Boost
boost.description: Warm a room up for a while, then go back to what it was doing.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: How long. Defaults to the house setting.
